# Contributing to BESHStatNG

Thanks for your interest in improving BESHStatNG.

## Reporting bugs

Before opening a bug report, please:

- confirm the issue in a simplified workbook if possible
- restart Excel and test again
- note the exact BESHStatNG version, Excel version, Office bitness, and Windows version
- copy the exact formula, selected options, or dialog path
- include screenshots, sample data, or a workbook if they help reproduce the problem
- remove confidential data before attaching files

## Good bug reports include

- exact steps to reproduce
- expected behavior
- actual behavior
- full error text or stack trace
- whether the issue affects GUI workflows, UDFs, charts, docs, or installation

## Validation notes for fixes

If you submit a fix, please describe how you validated it:

- unit tests added or updated
- manual Excel verification performed
- sample workbook or scenario used
- docs updated if user-facing behavior changed

## Pull requests

Please keep pull requests focused. Link the related issue when possible.
